calls.title: Pedro Tabacof and Ashley Stirrup
calls.summary: The meeting highlighted Fin's recent rebranding from Intercom to emphasize its AI-focused future, achieving over $100 million in revenue and nearly 10,000 customers. The company has evolved its product offerings beyond customer support into sales development and e-commerce solutions, using AI technology for diverse interactions. Fin's unique pricing model charges based on resolved queries, ensuring customer success aligns with revenue. A notable latency impact study revealed that increased response times did not detrimentally affect user satisfaction, challenging traditional assumptions. Additionally, the Apex model's iterative development process showcased the synergy between experimentation and AI product improvement. Looking forward, Fin aims to enhance its experimentation framework for scalable, enterprise-ready solutions while maintaining data integrity.
calls.keywords: AI experimentation, customer support AI, latency experiment, pricing model, A/B testing, experimentation platform
